evidence.quote:
10. I agree with your justification that reported effect sizes should not be used to compare the
effectiveness of teaching strategies due to their heterogeneity. This point could be made clearer in
Figure 3, where average effect sizes from meta-analyses are presented. Could this be misleading if
the average effect sizes are shown here?
RESPONSE: Suggestion to change the Figure label to “Average effect sizes from metaanalyses included in summaries of the most relevant teaching strategies vary greatly”
